subject: or_legislature/2025R1/HB2691
title: Provides that a manufactured-protein food product that bears a label suggesting that the food product is made from meat is misbranded unless the food product contains text disclosing that the food product is not made from meat.
headline: HB 2691 did not pass

claims.text: HB 2691 was introduced in the House on January 13, 2025.
HB 2691 was still in a House committee when the session ended. Last recorded step: June 27, 2025.
Each of the 3 recorded steps was checked against Oregon's chamber procedure and every move was a legal one.
